description: Follow one property (track), stop (untrack) or list tracked ones. Optional price_below threshold and min_drop_pct. Tracked properties produce alerts on every verified price or status change.

min_drop_pct.description: Only alert on reductions at least this large (percent).

price_below.description: Alert when the asking price (or rent) drops below this.

name: track_property
title: Track a property
